label: Hirschmann RS30 OpenRail 8-port + 2x 1G RJ45
description: Hirschmann RS30 compact OpenRail managed DIN-rail switch: 8x 100M RJ45 plus 2x 1G RJ45 uplink ports (10 ports in total), both gigabit uplinks on copper, store-and-forward, fanless, software Layer 2 Enhanced.
notes: Family facts from the vendor installation manual (https://www.doc.hirschmann.com/pdf/IG_RS20_RS30_RS40_Managed_08_0325_en_2025-03-27.pdf): an RS30 has two gigabit uplink ports ('Ports 1 and 2, 1000 Mbit/s, media selectable, SFP, RJ45') beside 8, 16 or 24 10/100 Mbit/s TP RJ45 ports. The V.24 management connection is an RJ11 socket and the separate USB port is only for the ACA21-USB auto-configuration adapter, so neither is a data port. Power 12/24/48 V DC (9.6-60 V) or 24 V AC (18-30 V) on a redundant 6-pin terminal block. Temperature class letter in the code: S = standard 0 to +60 C, T and E = extended -40 to +70 C. Software variant letter: E = Layer 2 Enhanced, P = Professional. Layer 2 only: Belden lists switching, redundancy and management, never routing, so these specs carry no l3-forward. Code check: 08 = 8 x 10/100 Mbit/s ports, 02 = 2 x 1000 Mbit/s ports, T1 T1 = both gigabit uplinks twisted-pair RJ45, S = 0 to +60 C, D = 9.6-60 V DC, A = CE/UL 508, E = Enhanced software. Datasheet: https://catalog.belden.com/techdata/EN/RS30-0802T1T1SDAE_techdata.pdf
